# AC/DC Refrigeration & Appliance Repair

> Commercial refrigeration and high-end appliance repair serving the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) metroplex. Walk-in coolers and freezers, commercial ice machines, reach-ins, and built-in residential appliances. Rated 4.8★ from 430+ Google reviews. Specialists in high-end and built-in brands (Sub-Zero, Wolf, Viking, Thermador) for luxury and custom homes. Same-day service available.

## Key facts

- **Business:** AC/DC Refrigeration & Appliance Repair (legal entity: AC-DC HVAC & Appliance Repair LLC)
- **Based in:** Grapevine, TX 76051, US — service-area business, no walk-in location; technicians travel to the customer
- **Phone:** (469) 224-0577
- **Service area:** Dallas–Fort Worth, TX — based in Grapevine (76051), serving Southlake, Westlake, Highland Park, University Park, Colleyville, Keller, Flower Mound, Trophy Club, Highland Village, Coppell, Carrollton, Irving, Grapevine, Bedford, Euless, Hurst, Dallas
- **Rating:** 4.8 out of 5 stars, 430+ verified Google reviews
- **Diagnostic fee:** $90, waived when you proceed with the repair
- **Dispatch hours:** Monday–Friday 8 AM–4 PM, Saturday 8 AM–1 PM. No technician dispatch on Sunday.
- **Same-day rule:** Requests submitted before 2 PM on a dispatch day (Mon–Sat) get same-day service. Requests after 2 PM, or on Sunday, are scheduled for the next available day at a time the customer picks.
- **Sunday:** Not closed-and-silent — the callback form accepts requests any time; Sunday submissions are scheduled first thing Monday.
- **Experience:** 7 years specializing in high-end and built-in appliances

## Commercial refrigeration (primary commercial service line)

We are a commercial refrigeration contractor as well as an appliance repair company — these are different trades and most DFW appliance companies only do the second one.

- **Walk-in coolers and walk-in freezers:** evaporator icing and defrost-cycle faults, condenser fouling, refrigerant leaks, compressor failure, stuck contactors, failed thermostats and temperature probes, blocked condensate drain lines, door gaskets and hinges, panel and threshold damage. Page: https://acdcdfw.com/walk-in-cooler-repair.html
- **Commercial ice machines:** Scotsman, Manitowoc, Hoshizaki. Low or no production, scale and water-quality faults, harvest-cycle failures. Page: https://acdcdfw.com/ice-machine-repair.html
- **Reach-in coolers and freezers, prep and sandwich tables, back-bar and undercounter units:** True, Traulsen, Beverage-Air, Turbo Air.
- **Who we serve:** independent restaurants and bars, restaurant groups, hotels, grocery and convenience retail, coworking operators, corporate cafeterias, property and facility managers.
- **Sealed-system work is performed in-house** — compressor replacement, refrigerant leak location and recovery, evaporator and condenser work — not subcontracted.
- **Refrigerants:** legacy R-22 systems and current R-448A/R-449A and R-290 equipment. R-22 availability drives the repair-versus-replace decision on older walk-in condensing units.
- **Preventive maintenance contracts:** from $349/year per location — scheduled coil cleaning, gasket and door inspection, temperature-log verification, drain-line service. This is the cheapest way to avoid an emergency call with a full box of product.
- **Documentation:** a written service record is provided for each visit, usable for health-department follow-up and insurance or spoilage claims.

## What we repair

- **High-end brands:** Sub-Zero, Wolf, Viking, Thermador, KitchenAid, JennAir, GE Monogram, Dacor, Miele, Bosch
- **Standard brands:** Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, Frigidaire, Maytag
- **Appliances:** refrigerators (built-in, integrated, columns), freezers, ice makers, wine coolers, ranges, cooktops, wall ovens
- **Refrigeration:** walk-in coolers, walk-in freezers, commercial ice machines, reach-in coolers and freezers, prep tables (see the commercial section above)
- **HVAC:** diagnostics and repair
- **Commercial:** restaurants, hotels, coworking spaces, retail. Standing service and preventive-maintenance agreements with multi-location operators across DFW. Contracts from $349/year per location.

## Why us

- Commercial refrigeration and built-in appliance specialists — not a general dispatch company. The owner diagnoses units personally.
- Sealed-system refrigeration work stays in-house rather than being handed to a subcontractor.
- Flat-rate quote provided before any work begins — no surprise charges.
- Honest assessment: if a repair doesn't make financial sense versus replacement, we say so.

## Guides and troubleshooting (blog)

Symptom-first repair guides written by the technician who runs the calls. Each names the precise symptom, what an owner or operator can safely check, what the repair costs, and when repair stops making sense.

- [Repair Guides Index](https://acdcdfw.com/blog/) — commercial refrigeration, ice machines, and built-in appliance troubleshooting
- [Walk-In Cooler Not Holding Temperature](https://acdcdfw.com/blog/walk-in-cooler-not-holding-temperature.html) — the 41°F threshold and Texas Food Establishment Rules, the five real causes (fouled condenser, stuck defrost, doors and gaskets, refrigerant leak, contactor and start components), first-30-minutes checklist, repair-vs-re-power on aging condensing units
- [Commercial Ice Machine Not Making Ice](https://acdcdfw.com/blog/commercial-ice-machine-not-making-ice.html) — Scotsman, Manitowoc, Hoshizaki. Symptom-to-cause table, water supply and filters, scale in hard North Texas water, condenser fouling and clearances, harvest-cycle failures, bin controls, maintenance intervals
- [Thermador Oven Not Heating](https://acdcdfw.com/blog/thermador-oven-not-heating.html) — symptom-to-cause map for no heat, slow preheat, uneven browning; bake element vs temperature sensor vs hot-surface igniter vs relay board; self-clean as a common trigger; typical $300–$1,400 repair range
- [Sub-Zero Refrigerator Not Cooling](https://acdcdfw.com/blog/sub-zero-not-cooling.html) — dirty condenser coils, evaporator fan and frost, door gaskets, sealed-system faults; DFW repair costs
